# 性能试验与数据换算

_Performance Testing & Data Reduction_

性能试验将测量结果转换为可解释、可比较的发动机性能证据。资料应保留试验条件、仪表标定、数据处理与参考状态，便于核对模型与实测之间的差别。

_Performance testing turns measurements into interpretable and comparable evidence. Retain test conditions, calibration, processing methods and reference states to explain differences between models and measurements._

## 阅读要点 / Reading Notes

- 分开保存原始测量、修正或换算后的结果，以及各自的不确定度说明。

_Keep raw measurements separate from corrected or reduced results, including uncertainty information._

- 核对安装、引气和功率提取等试验构型条件，再比较性能。

_Check installation, bleed and power-extraction conditions before comparing performance._

- 把计算方法、修正关系和标定版本与结果一起登记。

_Record the calculation methods, correction relationships and calibration revisions with the results._
